ud3.2:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud3.2:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evamāroceti:
ud3.2:1.5: na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ, sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmī”ti.
ud3.2:2.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud3.2:2.2: “āyasmā bhante nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evamāroceti.
ud3.2:2.3: “anabhirato ahaṃ āvuso brahmacariyaṃ carāmi. na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ. sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmī”ti.
ud3.2:3.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
ud3.2:3.2: “ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, mama vacanena nandaṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi:
ud3.2:3.4: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā nando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ etadavoca:
ud3.2:4.1: ‘evamāvuso’ti kho āyasmā nando tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
ud3.2:5.1: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ nanda, sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evamārocesi
ud3.2:5.2: “anabhirato ahaṃ āvuso brahmacariyaṃ carāmi. na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ. sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmīti.
ud3.2:6.1: “kissa pana tvaṃ nanda, anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carasi? na sakkosi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissasī?”ti.
ud3.2:6.2: “sākiyānī maṃ bhante janapadakalyāṇī gharā nikkhamantassa upaḍḍhullikhitehi kesehi apaloketvā maṃ etadavoca:
ud3.2:6.4: so kho ahaṃ bhante tamanussaramāno anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carāmi. na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ. sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmī”ti.
ud3.2:7.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bāhāya gahetvā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva jetavane antarahito devesu tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi.
ud3.2:8.1: tena kho pana samayena pañcamattāni accharāsatāni sakkassa devānamindassa upaṭṭhānaṃ āgatāni honti kakuṭapādāni.
ud3.2:8.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ āmantesi:
ud3.2:8.3: “passasi no tvaṃ nanda, imāni pañca accharāsatāni kakuṭapādānī?”ti.
ud3.2:9.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi nanda, katamā nu kho abhirūpatarā vā dassanīyatarā ca pāsādikatarā ca, sākiyānī vā janapadakalyāṇī imāni vā pañca accharāsatāni kakuṭapādānī?”ti.
ud3.2:9.3: evameva kho bhante sākiyānī janapadakalyāṇī imesaṃ pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ upanidhāya saṅkhampi na upeti, kalampi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti, upanidhimpi na upeti.
ud3.2:9.4: atha kho imāni pañca accharāsatāni abhirūpatarāni ce va dassanīyatarāni ca pāsādikatarānicā”ti.
ud3.2:10.2: ahaṃ te pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kakuṭapādāna”nti.
ud3.2:10.3: “sace me bhante bhagavā pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kakuṭapādānaṃ, abhiramissāmahaṃ bhante bhagavati brahmacariye”ti.
ud3.2:11.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva devesu tāvatiṃsesu antarahito jetavane pāturahosi.
ud3.2:12.2: “āyasmā kira nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto accharānaṃ hetu brahmacariyaṃ carati,
ud3.2:12.3: bhagavā kirassa pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kakuṭapādāna”nti.
ud3.2:13.1: atha kho āyasmato nandassa sahāyakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bhatakavādena ca upakkitakavādena ca samudācaranti.
ud3.2:13.2: “bhatako kirāyasmā nando, upakkitako kirāyasmā nando, accharānaṃ hetu brahmacariyaṃ carati.
ud3.2:13.3: bhagavā kirassa pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kakuṭapādāna”nti.
ud3.2:14.1: atha kho āyasmā nando sahāyakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhatakavādena ca upakkitakavādena ca aṭṭīyamāno harāyamāno jigucchamāno eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti. tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
ud3.2:14.2: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti abbhaññāsi.
ud3.2:14.3: aññataro kho panāyasmā nando arahataṃ ahosi.
ud3.2:15.1: atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud3.2:15.2: “āyasmā bhante nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī”ti.
ud3.2:15.4: “nando āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī”ti.
ud3.2:16.1: atha kho āyasmā nando tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā nando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud3.2:16.2: “yaṃ me bhante bhagavā pāṭibhogo, pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kakuṭapādānaṃ. muñcāmahaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ etasmā paṭissavā”ti.
ud3.2:16.3: mayāpi kho te nanda cetasā ceto paricca vidito:
ud3.2:16.4: “nando āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’ti.
ud3.2:16.6: “āyasmā bhante nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī”ti.
ud3.2:16.7: yadeva kho te nanda anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ, athāhaṃ mutto etasmā paṭissavā”ti.
ud3.2:17.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
